def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = case['required_symbols']
    node_by_id = {node['id']: node for node in nodes}
    root_id = next(node['id'] for node in nodes if node['parent'] is None)
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        pid = node['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children.setdefault(pid, []).append(node['id'])
    retained = set(node['id'] for node in nodes)
    removal_order = []
    # Build list of candidate nodes
    candidates = []
    for node in nodes:
        if node['removable'] and node['id'] != root_id and node['symbol'] not in required_symbols:
            candidates.append(node)
    # Sort by depth descending, then id ascending
    candidates.sort(key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    for c in candidates:
        cid = c['id']
        if cid not in retained:
            continue
        # Check if any children still retained
        if cid in children:
            has_retained_child = any(child in retained for child in children[cid])
            if has_retained_child:
                continue
        # Tentatively remove
        new_retained = retained - {cid}
        # Check required symbols
        symbols_after = set()
        for nid in new_retained:
            symbols_after.add(node_by_id[nid]['symbol'])
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbols_after):
            retained = new_retained
            removal_order.append(cid)
    sorted_retained = sorted(retained)
    return {'retained_ids': sorted_retained, 'removal_order': removal_order}
